title: How a backyard pond is built
caption: A pond is a tiny water treatment plant 🐟 #howitsbuilt #pond #koi #backyard #howitworks

lines.text: If you dig a hole in your yard and fill it with water, it soaks right into the dirt.
So you line the hole with a rubber *liner*, which holds every drop.
But sharp rocks and roots poke holes in it from underneath.
So first you lay down a thick pad called *underlayment*, like the padding under a carpet.
Now you fill it up. But still water turns warm, green, and full of mosquitoes.
So you drop in a *pump* to keep the water moving.
It pushes the water up to a *waterfall*, and the splashing mixes fresh air back in.
But floating leaves sink and rot on the bottom.
So a *skimmer* box at the edge pulls them into a net before they sink.
Now fish can live in it. But fish poop, and their waste turns into *ammonia*, which poisons them.
So the water runs through a *filter* full of good bacteria, which turn the ammonia into something safer.
But sunlight still feeds the algae.
So you add *plants* that shade the water and soak up the food algae needs.
But to a heron, your pond looks like an all-you-can-eat buffet.
So you dig it deep, and stack rocks into caves where the fish can hide.
